name: Chhoti Kahani
hooks: {topic}, aur ek sabak jo bhoola nahi jaata.
line_bank: Ek gaon me ek lohar rehta tha. Roz wahi kaam, wahi shaam.
Sab usse kehte: itna kaam karke faayda kya?
Wo hansta tha, kaam karta rehta tha.
Ek din gaon me nayi factory aayi. Sab log bhaagte hue gaye.
Par wo lohar gaya nahi. Usne apna kaam behtar karna shuru kiya.
Do saal baad factory band ho gayi.
Wo lohar abhi bhi kaam kar raha tha — kyunki uske haath, uski machine thi.
Is kahani ka sabak: skill ka koi competitor nahi hota.
Doosri kahani: ek ladka roz mandir ke bahar phool bechta tha.
Ek din ek bada aadmi rukka aur bola, tum yahan kyun khade ho?
Ladka bola: kyunki yahan se sab log guzarte hain.
Aadmi hansa aur wapas aaya do din baad, apni dukaan ka owner banane.
Sabak: opportunity khud dikhti hai, kam se kam tum dikho.
Teesri kahani: ek buzurg ke paas ek purana ghada tha.
Bhara hua ghada har roz wahi paani deta tha.
Ek din ghada bola: main tuta hua hoon, mujhe badal do.
Buzurg ne kaha: tere taad se hi ye aangan hara hai.
Sabak: consistent pani gamle se zyada zaroori hai.
Chhoti chhoti aadat hi zindagi ka ghar banati hai.
Kahani khatam, par seekh aaj se shuru.
cta: Aisi ek kahani roz — channel follow karo.
